video.title: Synthetic mechanic view on EV batteries

segments.text: In my shop, cars that were fast charged daily showed clearly faster battery degradation.
segments.speaker: mechanic

segments.text: Ninety percent after ten years is an exaggeration; expect around eighty percent capacity.
segments.speaker: mechanic

segments.text: In winter the heater cuts driving range by twenty to thirty percent.
segments.speaker: mechanic
